about: Which government's spending line a public employer's payroll is spending under, by the employer's classification. A payroll payment is booked against the first listed line the government's budget in force carries; an employer whose government is recorded (governmentFacts.governmentKey) books against that government, else the listed level, else the next level up that covers the town.
source: U.S. Census Bureau, Annual Survey of State and Local Government Finances, Government Finance and Employment Classification Manual (2006), functional categories: financial administration and general control, police protection, fire protection, elementary and secondary education, health, corrections; compensation of a function's employees is current operation spending under that function.
